user.title: Connect to NexusPlan
user.description:
In NexusPlan, open your project and go to Planners → Home Assistant → Connect Home Assistant. Enter the code it shows. Codes last 10 minutes.

This integration only reads your setup and sends it to NexusPlan; it never controls a device.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only for a NexusPlan development server.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to NexusPlan
reauth_confirm.description: The link to “{project}” was disconnected. Create a new code in NexusPlan (Planners → Home Assistant → Connect Home Assistant) and enter it here.

error.invalid_code: That code is not valid. It may have expired or already been used — create a new one in NexusPlan.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach NexusPlan. Check this Home Assistant can reach the internet.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the logs.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait ten minutes, then create a new code in NexusPlan and try again.

abort.already_configured: This NexusPlan project is already connected.
abort.wrong_project: That code is for a different NexusPlan project.
